title: refactor(rest): move the /meta per-item read routes into meta-item-read-routes.ts (#23050 slice 13b)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Sub-slice **13b** of the `rest-server.ts` split: the fourth `/meta` group. Group G4 of `RestServer#registerMetadataEndpointsInner` is ONE statement, `if (metadata.endpoints.item !== false)`, of 891 lines (base `rest-server.ts:5336`–`:6226` at `6e43b7bc3`). It moves whole, its switch included and re-indented one level, to a new module, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`, as `registerMetaItemReadRoutes`. The group registers four routes per base: the reverse reference sweep (`GET {metaPath}/:type/:name/references`), the layered read (`GET {metaPath}/:type/:name/layers`), the book tree (`GET {metaPath}/book/:name/tree`) and the item read (`GET {metaPath}/:type/:name`).

This follows the slicing plan (`os-dev-report` `6239704287`, sub-slice 13b), seat 1's ruling on it `6239783526` (quoted below), static-receiver ruling A `6205442867`, 13a's `handover_13b` list (report `6241822317`) and the claim `6243326550`. PR #24224 (13a, `df000d4b2`) is the shape copied.

Nothing else moves:
- the route table, the ordered server registrations, every server-visible handler and every INNER registration (method, path, metadata, arity, handler digest) are identical, base vs head and `origin/main` vs merge head, in 20 configurations;
- the published `dist/index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` are byte-identical, and so are both bundles' 39-name export lists;
- four tokens of the moved body changed, the ruled receivers (below).

`rest-server.ts` goes from 8,699 to 7,733 lines on the merged tree. G5–G8, the umbrella `registerMetadataEndpoints` and its guarded swap, the inner head's bindings, every handler body, `fetchCurrentMetaDocument` and the rest of the class head, `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `docs/adr/**` and `packages/spec/src/**` are untouched. #23050 stays open for 13c–13e.

## The ruling this follows (seat 1, `6239783526`, verbatim)

> - **Q1, A.** The four head bindings (`metadata`, `metaPath`, `isScoped`, `registerPerItemRoute`) reach each module as ONE `scope: MetaRouteScope` parameter, built once in the inner head. Each module destructures only what it uses, and body tokens are unchanged. The host stays class members only.
>   - `registerPerItemRoute` stays one closure that reads RestServer's guarded `routeManager` at call time. ⛔ No module-local copy: that would be a second copy of a helper (rule 2).
> - **Q2, A.** 13a's `meta-collection-routes.ts` hosts `MetaRouteScope` and takes `TransportScopedMetaRequest` from `ui-routes.ts`, re-pointing its readers in that PR. ⛔ Not `meta-item-read-gate.ts` while #24208 is open.
> - **Q3, A.** `rest-server-registrar-files.ts` exports a named subset, the `/meta` modules. The dogfood census's reachable count becomes "the umbrella's sites plus every site in that subset", and a control pins the subset against the number of module calls inside the inner method. This is declared at 13a with the anonymous-`401` ablation as the runtime proof.
>   - From 13c on, a module with no direct register site is controlled on `registerPerItemRoute(` instead.
>   - ⛔ No naming convention, and ⛔ never "let blindSpot rise".
> - **Q4, A.** `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY`, a `private static readonly` field set once at class evaluation, is handed over by value. 13b and 13d name it in their claims, together with each sub-slice's static-receiver tokens (13 in all, ruling A `6205442867`).
> - **Q5, A.** G4 (891 lines, one `if`) moves whole in 13b, with its switch. Slice 1 moved 1,181 lines. The fallback, if the review budget binds, is B: a move-only split called inside the remaining brace. ⛔ C (re-shaping the registrations) is not a move and not this card's.
> - **Q6.** A for the two body-only 13b helpers (`notImplementedRefusalAnswer`, `anonymousFormIntakeFingerprint`): they move with the body. B for `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` (13d): it stays and is exported, because its callee `mayReadAuthoringTrail` is a docs anchor (`system-context.mdx:108`). Two-home helpers (`sendMetaItemAbsent`, `stampAnonymousFormIntakeWarnings`) stay and gain `export`, as in slices 1 and 2.
>
> **Binding on every sub-slice (from the plan's measurements):**
> - **Hosts are built inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`**, at the position of the statements they replace, with `routeManager` passed by value. ⛔ Never in `registerRoutes`, the constructor, an instance cache or the umbrella above the swap: those capture the real manager, and the moved routes would mount outside the anonymous-deny gate (#3963) and the type-level admissions (#21087, #21124).
>   - Each sub-slice proves this with the guard ablation in the plan: an anonymous request at every moved route gets `401` on head, and the ablation does not.
> - **The proof gains an inner-registration leg.** Slice 12's handler digest is blind to `/meta`, because every route's server-visible handler is the same guard wrapper. So each sub-slice digests the inner handlers through a recording `routeManager` and a direct `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` call per base, with the ruled receiver tokens mapped back. A one-character positive control must move exactly that route's inner digest.
>   - The full-boot legs stay: `getRoutes()`, ordered registrations, `.d.ts`/`.d.cts`, and the 39-name export list.
>   - The config matrix is slice 12's 13 configs plus the `/meta` switches the plan names.
> - **Readers move in the same PR**, loud and silent alike, as the plan lists per sub-slice. Cross-lane edits are declared on #6017 (spec: liveness and gate tables) and #6023 (devx: checklist) before the PR. The `system-context.mdx` rows change with the sub-slice that moves their code.

Q5 A is taken: the statement moves whole, and fallback B was not needed.

## The shape

**Moved, at its position.** In the inner method, right after 13a's `registerMetaCollectionRoutes.call(collectionHost, scope);`, the head now builds the host literal `itemReadHost` and calls `registerMetaItemReadRoutes.call(itemReadHost, scope)` with the ONE existing `scope` (no second one is built). Registration order is unchanged: after the per-type list, above the item writes, with `/references` and `/layers` still above the item read.

**The host, `MetaItemReadRouteHost`: 16 members in first-read order** (a symbol-resolved walk of G4 with the TypeScript 6.0.3 compiler API, on base and head; H1 of the dispatch holds: G4 opened at `:5345`, its range ran `:5336`–`:6226`):

| member | reads | handed over as |
|---|---:|---|
| `routeManager` | 4 (all `register`, registration time) | **by value, captured inside the inner method** |
| `resolveProtocol` | 4 | closure `(...a) => this.resolveProtocol(...a)` |
| `metaTypeSingular` (private static) | 2 | closure `(...a) => RestServer.metaTypeSingular(...a)`, typed `(typeof RestServer)['metaTypeSingular']` |
| `resolveObjectMasker` | 2 | closure |
| `serveMetaItemLayered` | 2 | closure |
| `metaReadAudienceSources` | 1 | closure |
| `extractLocale` | 2 | closure |
| `resolveExecCtx` | 1 | closure, spelled exactly as the execctx census's forwarder |
| `resolveI18nService` | 1 | closure |
| `metaItemReadGate` | 1 | closure |
| `maskObjectDocument` | 1 | closure |
| `anonymousFormIntakeWarnings` | 1 | closure |
| `translateMetaEnvelope` | 2 | closure |
| `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` (private static readonly field) | 1 | **by value** (Q4 A), typed `(typeof RestServer)['STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY']` |
| `metaItemAnswerSources` | 1 | closure |
| `sendMetaReadRefusal` (private static) | 1 | closure `(...a) => RestServer.sendMetaReadRefusal(...a)` |

The body has no bare `this`, no `this[...]`, no `function` keyword and no assignment to a `this` member. It reads no instance FIELD at request time, so no member is a getter. `STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` is the first static FIELD any host carries. It is assigned once, at class evaluation, from `meta-item-read-gate.ts`' constant of the same name, and never reassigned, so the value captured is the object every read of it returned.

**Host placement (binding).** The literal is built inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, where `this.routeManager` is the umbrella's wrapping registrar for exactly the duration of the call. It is not built in `registerRoutes`, the constructor, an instance cache or the umbrella above the swap. The module header and the comment above the literal say why. The guard ablation below is the runtime proof.

**The scope (Q1 A).** The module opens with `const { metadata, metaPath, isScoped } = scope;`, the three bindings it reads: `metadata` for the switch and `enableCache`, `metaPath`, `isScoped`. `registerPerItemRoute` is not called by this module.

**The four changed tokens (ruling A, named in the claim).** At base `rest-server.ts` `:5474` and `:5623`, the layered read and the item read each call `RestServer.metaTypeSingular(req.params.type)`. In the item read's stored-version branch, `:6128` reads `RestServer.STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY` and `:6136` calls `RestServer.sendMetaReadRefusal(res, answer.refusal)`. Each is now `this.…` through the host (module `:321`, `:470`, `:975`, `:983`). Neither static method reads anything but its arguments, so the receiver is the whole difference.

**Module-level names** (the same walk, base vs head):
- **Moved with the body (Q6 A):** `notImplementedRefusalAnswer` (base `:1560`–`:1673`, with its 106-line docblock) and `anonymousFormIntakeFingerprint` (base `:1969`–`:1972`). They are byte-identical at the module's end, each under a pointer comment, and a pointer comment is left at each old position. No other file names either one.
- **Gained `export` (Q6, two homes):** `sendMetaItemAbsent` (also read by the class's `sendMetaReadRefusal` and the `/diff` door) and `stampAnonymousFormIntakeWarnings` (also read by the class head). The module imports both from `./rest-server.js`.
- **Already exported, imported from `./rest-server.js`:** `META_ITEM_REFERENCES_PARAMS` (the meta door tests import it from there), `metaItemPackageBinding` and `mayReadPendingDrafts`. All five names are read only at request time, so the two modules importing each other cannot see one uninitialised.
- **Imports that left `rest-server.ts`** (read only by the moved code, so `noUnusedLocals` would refuse them; a pointer comment is left at each): `foldVisibilityFingerprintIntoEtag`, `normalizeIfNoneMatch`, `resolveObjectSchemaRuntimeView` and `objectFieldVisibilityFingerprint` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`), `GetMetaItemCachedRequest` (`@objectstack/spec/api`), the local `META_ITEM_LAYERS_PARAMS` import (`./meta-item-read-gate.js`; the re-export that names it stays), and `boundedDeclaredRefusalMessage`, `declaredHttpStatus` and `thrownAnswerIsBareNotFound` (`./error-response.js`). The plan listed six of these nine. The other three left because the two helpers moved: `objectFieldVisibilityFingerprint` is read by the item read and by `anonymousFormIntakeFingerprint`, and the two `error-response.js` names only by `notImplementedRefusalAnswer`.
- **Unchanged provenance:** every other name is imported from the module `rest-server.ts` imports it from. `MetaRouteScope` and `TransportScopedMetaRequest` come from `./meta-collection-routes.js`.

## Proof

All runs went through `os-verify-lock`, with every exit captured before any pipe, unless noted. The base is `6e43b7bc3`. The head is `7b562222d`, and the merge head `083b60f20` (one merge of `origin/main` `2bcd406a2`) was measured against `origin/main` itself. Base and main were measured in a read-only comparison worktree at each commit.

**1. The moved text.** `git show 6e43b7bc3:packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts | sed -n 5336,6226p`, with one 4-space indent removed, was compared with `meta-item-read-routes.ts` `:183`–`:1073`, the body after the destructuring line.
- The raw `diff` exits 1 on exactly four lines: the four receiver tokens.
- With `this.(metaTypeSingular|STORED_VERSION_DOOR_POLICY|sendMetaReadRefusal)` mapped back to `RestServer.…`, `diff` exits 0 over all 891 lines. Both sides are sha256 `c9ac1ae545c47bc93ab05e8aa18f3b6493eea7afafa84f6b480c460e3de3327d`.
- Every non-empty line of the range carries the 8-space indent, no line has trailing whitespace, and every odd-backtick line is a comment.
- The two helpers: base `:1560`–`:1673` vs module `:1079`–`:1192` (114 lines) and base `:1969`–`:1972` vs module `:1196`–`:1199`, `diff` exit 0 on both.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports.** `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are sha256 `1f0f455d24836d47de60716233f1bd74d1738c04046974019264b17b5261bbe8` at base and at head. At `origin/main` `2bcd406a2` and at the merge head they are both `caa84a36073f1dd5a79f66d3bc71b877e3a60806d1f380d39b310987fb15d255` (main's #24223 edited a class-head docblock). `cmp` exits 0 on every pair.
- The head-only marker `registerMetaItemReadRoutes` hits 2 in each of `index.js` / `index.cjs`, and 0 at base and at main.
- Both bundles load with 39 exports and one sorted name list, sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…`, on every leg.

**3. Full-boot legs (slice 12's method), 20 configurations:** slice 12's thirteen, then the `/meta` switches under scoped-optional: `metadata.endpoints.types`, `.items`, `.item` and `.maintenance` each false; all four false; `metadata.prefix: '/metadata'`; `api.enableMetadata: false`. The route counts are 75 / 150 / 75 / 75 / 73 / 73 / 142 / 148 / 148 / 138 / 144 / 69 / 150, then 146 / 148 / 126 / 144 / 114 / 150 / 112 (13a's figures).
- **Source leg** (a `tsx` boot of `src/rest-server.ts`): `routes.json` (`getRoutes()`, functions as arity), `calls.json` (ordered server registrations with arity) and `handlers.json` (a whitespace-free sha256 of every server-visible handler) are byte-identical in all 20 configs: 60 of 60 files, base vs head and main vs merge head. The concatenation is sha256 `bd4f6685175a61ec…` on all four trees.
- **Bundle leg** (the same dump against the built `dist/index.js`): 60 of 60 identical, concatenation `20103136b32ff534…` on all four, under one declared normalization: esbuild's numeric alias suffix on an import name two bundled modules share. Measured by an identifier-set diff of the two bundles, the head gains exactly `itemReadHost`, `registerMetaItemReadRoutes` and three renumbered aliases (`rethrowAuthzStoreUnavailable4`, `ObjectSchemaMaskEvaluationError3`, `relateObjectSchemaMaskPosture3`), and loses none. Those three names are the ones normalized.

**4. The inner-registration leg (the plan's `proof_method`).** Each config builds a `RestServer` with a recording `routeManager` and calls `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` directly for `/api/v1` and `/api/v1/environments/:environmentId`: 688 recorded registrations over the 20 configs. Each is digested whitespace-free, with the four receiver tokens mapped back, together with its method, path, metadata and arity.
- **Source leg:** 688 of 688 identical, base vs head and main vs merge head; the digest-list sha256 is `4f306a2a19ffdd181b36b43e4d8b49d0844dc396c50a3144e8221aeab48b4511` on all four. Unnormalized, exactly 72 digests differ: the `/layers` and item routes on both bases in the 18 configs that mount them, the receiver tokens. This leg runs through `tsx`, whose per-file transform keeps import names as written, so 13a's vitest SSR renumbering does not arise and is not normalized.
- **Bundle leg:** 688 of 688 identical under the same three alias names; the digest-list sha256 is `8c47816fb3991d34bf792d04aab002f8e2c945de2e736ec93a93502c27ca3b7b` on all four.
- **Positive control.** One character was added in the moved book-tree handler through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `META_QUERY_ARITY_DOORS['book-tree']` became `['book-tree!']` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `5f398b048095` → `5b5bea5dcfbd`). The inner digests moved at exactly `GET …/book/:name/tree`, on both bases, in the 18 configs that mount it: 36 of 688, and nowhere else. All 20 configs' full-boot `routes` / `calls` / `handlers` stayed byte-identical: the blind spot the inner leg covers. Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**5. The guard ablation** (13a's recipe). One literal multi-line anchor ran from the umbrella's `const realRouteManager = this.routeManager;` through `itemReadHost`'s `routeManager: this.routeManager,` (blob `8f0876b93743` → `f2e20e0ca141`). The mutation stashes the real manager above the swap and has `itemReadHost` read it: the plan's wrong placement.
- **Head** (identical to base): an anonymous request at each moved route on both bases. `/references`, `/layers` and the item read answer `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` with zero protocol calls (6 of 6). The book tree is the declared anonymous public-audience read (#3963): the umbrella lets it through to the handler's own audience gate, which answers `401` "This documentation requires sign-in". All 8 server-visible handlers are the umbrella's wrapper.
- **Ablation:** `/references` answers `200` and the item read `200`, each after a protocol read; `/layers` answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` after a protocol read. Not one of the six is `401`, and none of the 8 handlers is the wrapper.
- **Standing pins under the ablation:** `Test Files 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`, `Tests 19 failed | 81 passed (100)`. `meta-type-read-capability.test.ts` is red 19 times (the `/:type/:name/layers` shape and the item read's shapes for the datasource family × member / author / other-grant, the existing-vs-absent byte identity, and the admin-door parity for three bearers). `rest-meta-auth.test.ts` stays green (its probes are routes 13b does not move), and `meta-type-write-capability.test.ts` stays green (no moved non-GET door).
- Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No permanent test was added.

**6. The late-binding ablation** (one-off script, deleted). The 12 methods are planted on the server and the 2 static methods on the class before `registerRoutes()`, as recorders that delegate to the originals. Ten request shapes are driven over the four moved routes (`?state=draft`, `?layers=true`, a view, an app, a doc and a masked object posture among them). Then everything is planted again and the shapes are driven again.
- **Head** (byte-identical `MEASURE` lines to base): all 14 closure members are reached before and after the re-plant, with `early calls after re-plant: 0`.
- **Ablation:** `metaItemReadGate: this.metaItemReadGate.bind(this)` (blob `8f0876b93743` → `85cc12e79126`) gives `early calls after re-plant: 3 ["early:metaItemReadGate"]` and 13 late members, exit 1. Restored: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

`rest-server-registrar-files.ts` gains `meta-item-read-routes.ts` in `REST_SERVER_REGISTRAR_FILES` (length 14 → 15) and in the named `/meta` subset `REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES` (1 → 2). H2 holds: the dogfood control counts `.call(` inside the inner method, now 2, so the subset and the call moved together.

| reader | sum over the list | change |
|---|---|---|
| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 12 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 0 + 6 + 3 + 1; mentions 133 → 137 | The item read's site is locally caught on its continuation line, as before, so the split stays 16 / 46, and §7's and §8's four continuation sites are found again. `rest-server.ts` stays at 55 mentions (the site and one prose mention out, one forwarder's two in); the module carries 4. Fifteen forwarders: (15 − 1) + 3 − 2 |
| `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` | 8 = 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 2 + 0 ×7 + 3 + 2 | The item read's `?state=draft` and `?preview=draft` moved. Keys name routes, so no ledger row changed |
| `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts` | 9 = 8 + 1 + 0 ×13 | — |
| `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` (`repo`) | 4 = 0 + 3 + 0 ×10 + 1 + 0 + 0 | Floor `meta-item-read-routes.ts: 0` |
| `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` | floors sum 54 → 59 | The module carries 5: the header, the host interface, the function and the two moved helpers' blocks. `rest-server.ts` 163 → 161 blocks, floor 100 |
| `ui-view-route-identity` / `-tenancy` measurement tests | `this.enforceAuth(` 60, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 76 → 77 | +1 for the forwarder. The ownership guard is still 1 call site and 1 forwarder |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` | 0 tripwire hits over fifteen files | Length 14 → 15 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged | Reachable holds by 13a's Q3 rule, with no rule change. New control `meta-item-read-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 4; `/meta subset ↔ .call(` 2. `this.routeManager.register(` stays 63 = 2 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 6 + 6 + 4; `registerPerItemRoute(` 8 and `enforceAuth` 112 unchanged |

Readers outside the list:
- **`scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`** (`MODULES` only; declared on #6017, `6243336904`). `meta-item-read-routes.ts` is declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559 at `stringError 1` / `siblingCode 1`: the `/layers` door's 501 `{ error, code }` body. `rest-server.ts` goes 8 → 7 and 4 → 3, each with a "NOT progress — the same MOVE" note. The sums are unchanged at 39 and 54. Output: 25 → 26 modules audited, 15 → 16 ratcheted; `--self-test` exit 0.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`** (a loud cross-package reader). ⚠️ **The plan's 13b reader list missed it** (H3): 13a left its item, tree and layers derivations reading `rest-server.ts`, and at the move commit it reads `GET ${metaPath}/:type/:name in …/rest-server.ts: expected false to be true`. The route derivation now finds the handlers in `meta-item-read-routes.ts` and still reads the class method `serveMetaItemLayered` in `rest-server.ts`. Outside the declared list, so it is named here for the seat. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` exits 0.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`** (declared on #6017). `enableCache` now cites `meta-item-read-routes.ts#registerMetaItemReadRoutes`. `endpoints.item` splits across two files, as the declaration says: the `if` half cites the module, and the `registerPerItemRoute` half keeps `rest-server.ts#registerMetadataEndpointsInner`. `prefix` stays.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/doc.json`** and **`book.json`** (declared on #6017). In `doc.json`, `content.evidence` gains the module for the single-item branch, and `_note` names it for the book-tree and single-item branches. The `doc` list branch keeps its `rest-server.ts#registerMetadataEndpointsInner` citation and its quote: the quote is already stale (that code lives in `meta-item-read-gate.ts`), and that is the spec seat's to repair, as routed, so it is not edited here. In `book.json`, `_note` names the module for the `book/:name/tree` branch.
  - `check:liveness`: `947 pointer(s) … 947 naming a symbol` (945 before) and `737 … pair(s) asked, 736 anchored, 1 exempt` (735 / 734 / 1 before). Measured at the move commit, before these edits, it stayed green: these readers are silent.
- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`** (declared on #20163, `6243347725`):
  - `api-backend.rest-metadata-config-contract`: `+ packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts#registerMetaItemReadRoutes (the item endpoint gate on the per-item reads)` is added beside the inner anchor. The inner anchor's parenthetical goes from "metaPath, the item endpoint gate and registerPerItemRoute" to "metaPath and registerPerItemRoute", because the `if` moved (13a made the same kind of edit).
  - `platform-core` (the book tree): `rest-server.ts#metaPath` → `meta-item-read-routes.ts#registerMetaItemReadRoutes`. The text after the anchor is unchanged. `metaPath` still resolves in the inner head, so leaving it would have stayed silently wrong.
  - `check:platform-checklist` exit 0; `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0, `12 anchor(s) judged, 0 lost`.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__meta-item-read-routes.ts.json`** (NEW; outside the declared list, named for the seat). `check-adr-anchors` checks `ADR-NNNN Dk` letters only in anchored files. The move took G4's letter citations out of the anchored `rest-server.ts`, and the gate read 1776 → 1760 while green: a reader that narrowed silently, the shape card rule 3 forbids. Slices 4, 6, 7 and 11 met this with an anchor, and this does the same. It anchors ADR-0106 and ADR-0046, its invariant adds no letter citation of its own, and the reading is back to 1776.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__meta-collection-routes.ts.json`** (NEW, its own commit `7b562222d`, an in-place repair of 13a's same narrowing). Measured on 13a's own two commits, `b9ac35cbf` → `df000d4b2` moved the reading 1783 → 1776 with the gate green. This anchors ADR-0131 and ADR-0106, its invariant adds no letter citation, and the reading becomes 1783. It is the same defect class, the same mechanical shape, a new file no claim holds, and the same gate. Dropping the commit restores 1776 and nothing else.

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the readers at their base text:
- **At the move commit `6fa5946df`:**
  - `local` read `Test Files 2 failed | 292 passed (294)`, `Tests 6 failed | 6021 passed | 326 skipped (6353)`. The execctx census failed four times: `expected 61 to be 62`, `expected 15 to be 16`, and §7 and §8 `expected 3 to be greater than or equal to 4` (a continuation site out of reach). The draft census failed twice (`expected [ …(6) ] to deeply equal [ …(8) ]`).
  - The dogfood pair read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)`: `expected 66 to be 70`, and `this.routeManager.register(` `expected 59 to be 63`.
  - The runtime parity test read `Tests 1 failed | 738 passed (739)`.
  - `check:route-envelope` exited 1: `meta-item-read-routes.ts NOT DECLARED` (`MODULES` and the express table), `stringError: found 7, declared 8`, `siblingCode: found 3, declared 4`.
  - `check-adr-anchors` stayed green at 1760 (base 1776), `check:liveness` and `check:platform-checklist` stayed green, and `repo` stayed `5 passed` (G4 carries no `query:` slot). Those are the silent readers.
- **At `8a8a105cb`** (the list grown, the readers not yet re-pointed):
  - The six list readers read `Test Files 6 failed (6)`, `Tests 7 failed | 119 passed (126)`: the length pins and the unfloored module.
